levels.title: Artists with more than one hit (HAVING)
levels.task: Stellar Sound wants a short report: each artist and how many chart songs they have, but only if they have 2 or more songs. Columns artist and song_count (COUNT(*)). Use HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2. ORDER BY song_count high to low, then artist A–Z. This site checks names and order.
levels.solution:
SELECT artist, COUNT(*) AS song_count
FROM top_songs
GROUP BY artist
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY song_count DESC, artist;
levels.hintMessage: WHERE runs before GROUP BY. HAVING runs after the count—use it to drop small groups.
levels.successMessage: Great! HAVING keeps only artists with enough songs on the chart.

levels.title: Very new acts (MIN + HAVING)
levels.task: A&R at Stellar Sound wants artists whose first chart date is after 2024-03-01. Show artist and earliest_release = MIN(release_date). Use HAVING on that MIN date. Sort by artist A–Z.
levels.initialCode: -- SELECT artist, MIN(release_date) AS earliest_release ... GROUP BY artist HAVING ...
levels.solution:
SELECT artist, MIN(release_date) AS earliest_release
FROM top_songs
GROUP BY artist
HAVING MIN(release_date) > '2024-03-01'
ORDER BY artist;
levels.hintMessage: Put the date test in HAVING with MIN(release_date), not only in WHERE on one row.
levels.successMessage: Great! Every artist here is new on the chart after that date.

levels.title: CASE: two spotlight labels
levels.task: Marketing at Stellar Sound needs simple tags. Columns: track_name, artist, spotlight. CASE: if artist is Beyoncé OR artist starts with Dua Lip (LIKE 'Dua Lip%'), spotlight = 'Pop Princess'. Else 'Other'. Only ids 1003, 5, 6, 1005. ORDER BY id. Copy the quoted words exactly.
levels.initialCode: -- CASE WHEN artist = 'Beyoncé' OR artist LIKE 'Dua Lip%' THEN ... ELSE ... END
levels.solution:
SELECT track_name, artist,
  CASE
    WHEN artist = 'Beyoncé' OR artist LIKE 'Dua Lip%' THEN 'Pop Princess'
    ELSE 'Other'
  END AS spotlight
FROM top_songs
WHERE id IN (1003, 5, 6, 1005)
ORDER BY id;
levels.hintMessage: CASE checks each WHEN in order; use the Beyoncé and Dua tests before ELSE.
levels.successMessage: Nice! CASE turns many values into two easy labels.

levels.title: CASE: Top 3 or not
levels.task: The newsletter team at Stellar Sound needs tiers. For ids 1001–1005: show id, track_name, chart_status. If id is 1001, 1002, or 1003, chart_status = 'Top 3'. Else chart_status = 'Honorable Mention'. ORDER BY id. Match spelling exactly.
levels.initialCode: -- CASE WHEN id IN (1001, 1002, 1003) THEN 'Top 3' ELSE ... END
levels.solution:
SELECT id, track_name,
  CASE
    WHEN id IN (1001, 1002, 1003) THEN 'Top 3'
    ELSE 'Honorable Mention'
  END AS chart_status
FROM top_songs
WHERE id BETWEEN 1001 AND 1005
ORDER BY id;
levels.hintMessage: WHERE id BETWEEN 1001 AND 1005 keeps the list short. CASE picks the tier text.
levels.successMessage: Perfect! Simple tiers help posters and web banners.

levels.title: Count songs before and after April
levels.task: Extra practice at Stellar Sound: only artists Sabrina Carpenter, Taylor Swift, Kendrick Lamar. For each artist show artist, before_april (SUM of 1 when release_date < 2024-04-01 else 0), from_april_on (SUM of 1 when release_date >= 2024-04-01 else 0). GROUP BY artist. ORDER BY artist. No extra columns.
levels.initialCode: -- Filter artists IN (...); SUM(CASE ...) for each bucket
levels.solution:
SELECT artist,
  SUM(CASE WHEN release_date < '2024-04-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS before_april,
  SUM(CASE WHEN release_date >= '2024-04-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS from_april_on
FROM top_songs
WHERE artist IN ('Sabrina Carpenter', 'Taylor Swift', 'Kendrick Lamar')
GROUP BY artist
ORDER BY artist;
levels.hintMessage: Each CASE gives 1 or 0 per song; SUM adds them inside each artist group.
levels.successMessage: Strong work! You split counts by date in one grouped query.
